threads.subject: Cracked chainstay on my Lumen Commuter

messages.text:
Hi Lumen team,

I noticed a hairline crack on the left chainstay of my Commuter this morning, right by the dropout. The bike is seven months old and I mostly ride it to work on paved roads.

Photo and receipt attached. Is this covered by the frame warranty? I'd rather not ride it until someone has looked at it.

Thanks,
Ana

messages.text: Hi, I ordered a size L Commuter (LB-20391) but at 1.74 m it's too big for me. It's unridden. Can I swap it for an M?

Hi Tomás,

Of course. I've emailed a prepaid return label separately. Once the L is scanned at the depot we'll ship the M the same day.

Lumen Support
Love the bike! One thing: the kickstand rattles a lot on cobbled streets. Is there a fix?
Thanks Hannah! Tightening the kickstand bolt to 8 Nm usually fixes it. We're also shipping a rubber damper with new bikes from next month and can post you one.
Hi, I'm writing a piece on cargo e-bikes for families and would love 20 minutes with someone from Lumen this week. Are you free?
Hi Jo, happy to. Would Thursday at 11:00 work? Our founder can join.

messages.text: A cardholder has disputed a payment of €2,390.00 for order LB-19902 (reason: product not received). Submit evidence by 2026-11-02 or the dispute will be decided in the cardholder's favour.
My range has dropped from about 80 km to 55 km since it got cold. Is the battery failing?
Hi Lars, that's normal: lithium batteries lose 20–30% of their range below 5°C. Keep the battery indoors and fit it just before you ride. If it's still low in spring, we'll test it for free.
